Migrate the exact root TRDs, complete the redesign document under the new lifecycle, verify plan handoff, and prove the integrated result.

## Scope

- Root TRD preflight and migration
- Catalog validation
- Current-revision TRD approval
- Planning handoff

## Entry conditions
